title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十三章、珠花与食盒

    包拯和公孙策在冷宫见到了蓝香，但蓝香的精神好像真的有点儿问题。
    包拯放慢语速，温和地问她：“二十一年前，冷宫大火，很多人死了，他们是被烧死的，你还记得吗？那时候你受伤了吗？”
    “火……烧死……”蓝香想到什么，害怕地抱紧了小被子：“杀人了……他们杀人了……”
    “谁被杀了？谁杀人了？”包拯追问。
    “很多人……杀了很多人，娘娘……他们要杀娘娘……”
    “哪个娘娘？谁要杀娘娘？”包拯震惊地追问。
    蓝香的神色突然变了，像是变了一个人，她小声地问：“你们……是谁？”
    公孙策连忙说道：“蓝香，他是包拯，我是公孙策，我们都是从开封府来的，你知道开封府吗？包拯就是开封府的包大人，是大家都信任的好人。你有什么事情，都可以和他说，他会帮你的！”
    蓝香一动不动地看着包拯，不知道在想什么。包拯想等她继续说，但她却又抱紧了被子：“好孩子，别哭，别哭……”
    公孙策想了想，问包拯：“那枝珠花你带在身上吗？”
    包拯明白他的意思，马上从衣服里拿出楚珠的珠花，送到蓝香手里，问：“蓝香，你认识这枝珠花吗？”
    蓝香微微一愣，摸着珠花，手指在珍珠上一颗一颗地慢慢摸着。
    包拯温和地说道：“旁边这一圈小点儿的珍珠，是白色的。圈里面大一些的那颗珍珠，是紫色的。它是一个宫女的，二十一年前她也在冷宫。她叫楚珠，你认识她吗？”
    “楚……珠……”蓝香回忆着这个名字，慢慢地，她的手指开始用力，她把珠花抓得越来越紧，她变得紧张起来，她飞快地把“孩子”送到包拯手里，惊慌地说：“楚珠，你走吧……”说完她转身在房间里慌乱地翻找起来，一边找还一边小声地说：“怎么办……怎么办……”
    “你在找什么？”包拯问。
    她却像没有听见，仍然不停地翻找。她找到一个小箱子，小心地举到包拯面前：“这个……这个可以吗？放进去，放在里面就不会被发现了……”
    “这是什么？”包拯完全听不懂她的话。
    “食盒……孩子睡着了，他很安静……不会有人发现的……”她小声地说。
    包拯震惊地瞪大了双眼，公孙策急得一把拉住蓝香：“食盒里装的是孩子？”
    蓝香好像这时候才看到公孙策，她像是认出了他，微笑着说：“马超，你也来了。”
fullText.traditional:
第二十三章、珠花與食盒

    包拯和公孫策在冷宮見到了藍香，但藍香的精神好像真的有點兒問題。
    包拯放慢語速，溫和地問她：“二十一年前，冷宮大火，很多人死了，他們是被燒死的，你還記得嗎？那時候你受傷了嗎？”
    “火……燒死……”藍香想到什麼，害怕地抱緊了小被子：“殺人了……他們殺人了……”
    “誰被殺了？誰殺人了？”包拯追問。
    “很多人……殺了很多人，娘娘……他們要殺娘娘……”
    “哪個娘娘？誰要殺娘娘？”包拯震驚地追問。
    藍香的神色突然變了，像是變了一個人，她小聲地問：“你們……是誰？”
    公孫策連忙說道：“藍香，他是包拯，我是公孫策，我們都是從開封府來的，你知道開封府嗎？包拯就是開封府的包大人，是大家都信任的好人。你有什麼事情，都可以和他說，他會幫你的！”
    藍香一動不動地看著包拯，不知道在想什麼。包拯想等她繼續說，但她卻又抱緊了被子：“好孩子，別哭，別哭……”
    公孫策想了想，問包拯：“那枝珠花你帶在身上嗎？”
    包拯明白他的意思，馬上從衣服裡拿出楚珠的珠花，送到藍香手裡，問：“藍香，你認識這枝珠花嗎？”
    藍香微微一愣，摸著珠花，手指在珍珠上一顆一顆地慢慢摸著。
    包拯溫和地說道：“旁邊這一圈小點兒的珍珠，是白色的。圈裡面大一些的那顆珍珠，是紫色的。它是一個宮女的，二十一年前她也在冷宮。她叫楚珠，你認識她嗎？”
    “楚……珠……”藍香回憶著這個名字，慢慢地，她的手指開始用力，她把珠花抓得越來越緊，她變得緊張起來，她飛快地把“孩子”送到包拯手裡，驚慌地說：“楚珠，你走吧……”說完她轉身在房間裡慌亂地翻找起來，一邊找還一邊小聲地說：“怎麼辦……怎麼辦……”
    “你在找什麼？”包拯問。
    她卻像沒有聽見，仍然不停地翻找。她找到一個小箱子，小心地舉到包拯面前：“這個……這個可以嗎？放進去，放在裡面就不會被發現了……”
    “這是什麼？”包拯完全聽不懂她的話。
    “食盒……孩子睡著了，他很安靜……不會有人發現的……”她小聲地說。
    包拯震驚地瞪大了雙眼，公孫策急得一把拉住藍香：“食盒裡裝的是孩子？”
    藍香好像這時候才看到公孫策，她像是認出了他，微笑著說：“馬超，你也來了。”

sentences.pinyin: shí hé hái zi shuì zháo le tā hěn ān jìng bú huì yǒu rén fā xiàn de tā xiǎo shēng de shuō
sentences.english: “Food box … The child is asleep, he’s very quiet … No one will find out …” she said in a low voice.

sentences.simplified: 包拯震惊地瞪大了双眼，公孙策急得一把拉住蓝香：“食盒里装的是孩子？”
sentences.traditional: 包拯震驚地瞪大了雙眼，公孫策急得一把拉住藍香：“食盒裡裝的是孩子？”
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng zhèn jīng de dèng dà le shuāng yǎn gōng sūn cè jí de yì bǎ lā zhù lán xiāng shí hé lǐ zhuāng de shì hái zi
sentences.english: Bao Zheng’s eyes widened in shock, and Gongsun Ce quickly grabbed Lan Xiang: “Is the child inside the food box?”

sentences.simplified: 蓝香好像这时候才看到公孙策，
sentences.traditional: 藍香好像這時候才看到公孫策，
sentences.pinyin: lán xiāng hǎo xiàng zhè shí hou cái kàn dào gōng sūn cè
sentences.english: Lan Xiang seemed to notice Gongsun Ce for the first time.

sentences.simplified: 她像是认出了他，微笑着说：“马超，你也来了。”
sentences.traditional: 她像是認出了他，微笑著說：“馬超，你也來了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā xiàng shì rèn chū le tā wēi xiào zhe shuō mǎ chāo nǐ yě lái le
sentences.english: She appeared to recognize him and smiled, saying, “Ma Chao, you’re here too.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 23: The Hairpin and the Food Box
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce met Lan Xiang in the Cold Palace, but Lan Xiang really seemed to have some mental issues.
Bao Zheng slowed down his speech and gently asked her, ..
.. “Twenty-one years ago, there was a great fire in the Cold Palace, and many people died. They were burned to death.
Do you remember that? Were you injured at that time?”
“Fire … burned to death …” Lan Xiang thought of something and fearfully clutched her small quilt: “Murder … they committed murder …”
“Who was killed? Who did it?” Bao Zheng pressed further.
“Many people … they killed many people. The noble consort … they wanted to kill the noble consort …”
“Which noble consort? Who wanted to kill the noble consort?” Bao Zheng asked in shock.
Lan Xiang’s expression suddenly changed, as if she had become a different person.
She asked in a low voice, “Who … are you?”
Gongsun Ce quickly said, “Lan Xiang, he is Bao Zheng, and I am Gongsun Ce.
We both come from Kaifeng Mansion. Do you know Kaifeng Mansion?
Bao Zheng is Lord Bao from Kaifeng Mansion. He is a good person whom everyone trusts.
If you need anything, just let him know, and he will help you!”
Lan Xiang stared at Bao Zheng without moving, her thoughts a mystery.
Bao Zheng wanted to wait for her to continue speaking, but she just hugged the quilt tightly again:
“Good child, don’t cry, don’t cry …”
Gongsun Ce thought for a moment, then asked Bao Zheng, “Do you have that hairpin with you?”
Bao Zheng understood what he meant, and immediately took out Chu Zhu’s hairpin from his clothes.
He handed it to Lan Xiang, and asked, “Lan Xiang, do you recognize this hairpin?”
Lan Xiang was slightly taken aback. She touched the hairpin, her fingers slowly feeling each pearl one by one.
Bao Zheng said gently, “The smaller pearls around the edge are white. The larger pearl inside the circle is purple.
It belongs to a palace maid who was also in the Cold Palace twenty-one years ago.
Her name was Chu Zhu. Did you know her?”
“Chu … Zhu …” Lan Xiang recalled this name.
Slowly, her fingers began to tighten, gripping the hairpin more and more firmly. She started to become nervous.
She quickly handed the “child” to Bao Zheng and said in a panic, “Chu Zhu, you should leave …”
After saying that, she turned around and started to search frantically in the room, while saying in a low voice, ..
.. “What to do … What to do …”
“What are you looking for?” Bao Zheng asked.
But she acted as if she hadn’t heard and kept on searching relentlessly.
She found a small box and carefully held it up in front of Bao Zheng:
“This … will this work? If we put him inside, he won’t be discovered …”
“What is this?” Bao Zheng couldn’t understand her at all.
“Food box … The child is asleep, he’s very quiet … No one will find out …” she said in a low voice.
Bao Zheng’s eyes widened in shock, and Gongsun Ce quickly grabbed Lan Xiang: “Is the child inside the food box?”
Lan Xiang seemed to notice Gongsun Ce for the first time.
She appeared to recognize him and smiled, saying, “Ma Chao, you’re here too.”
